findings.summary: On Timeout the new loop resends immediately; it no longer asks the registry for the transaction's status, so a command whose reply was lost after execution is executed twice.
findings.evidence: README 'Retries' requires status() before resending. Scripted run: ScriptedTransport(['timeout-after', 'ok']) -> transport.executed == ['txn-1', 'txn-1'] with the patch, ['txn-1'] before it.

findings.summary: REGISTRIES replaces POLICIES but has no .de entry, so .de now falls back to DEFAULT and is retried up to three times; DENIC rejects repeated transaction ids and may suspend the account.
findings.evidence: policy_for('de') returns DEFAULT (max_attempts=3) with the patch; before it returned max_attempts=1 with no retryable errors. The PR's tests never send to .de.

findings.summary: _errors reimplements tuple(sorted(set(...))) with a nested loop.
findings.evidence: Behavior is the same; this is a simplification only.

tests_run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . (with pr-184.patch applied, in a scratch copy)
